title: BOS-1174 an unproven refresh chain is reported as its own state, not as health

scenes.title: a check that passed on a credential whose refresh chain was never observed working

expect.label: the new verdict is rendered as ITSELF rather than folded into a state this surface already knew; before this change the same row was an unqualified green and the operator had eight silent days before a hard failure
the account is still ACTIVE and its health still reads ok: an unproven refresh chain is a warning, not a provider rejection, so it does not remove the account from selection

scenes.title: the warning is distinct from both a clean check and a rejected credential

steps.caption: The same list, read for what the four rows say about each other

expect.label: a credential the daemon asked about, which answered, and whose refresh chain raised no question: the only row still entitled to an unqualified green
a CONFIRMED provider rejection, the one outcome that benches an account — the state the new one must never be confused with

expect.text: personal-codex codex disabled failed never checked
expect.label: an account nobody has ever asked about; 'never checked' remains its own answer, so the new state adds a fourth distinct verdict rather than blurring the existing three
